reads_against.argmap: Why is knower-difference really power-difference? → Eliminative argument: only power can be karaṇī-kartṛ; attributing difference to anything else regresses — hence bheda = uparāga of śakti.
c1_essence: Only power can be karaṇī-kartṛ: instrument→agent difference ends in uparāga-śakti, no regress.
